title: A scoped trial with the hard cases routed to people.
summary: About 8,000 emails a week, 4% of all UK customer email; satisfaction 76% against 72% for human advisors.

spec.problem: Routine customer emails to the UK supplier consumed advisor time. No baseline count was published.
spec.changed: A three-month trial of an assistant answering routine emails end to end. Vulnerable customers, sensitive cases and complex complaints went to humans.
spec.systems: Kraken operating platform, owned by Octopus.
spec.measured: Emails handled per week, share of total email, satisfaction against comparable human replies.
spec.result: **About 8,000 emails a week, 4% of all UK customer email; satisfaction 76% against 72% for human advisors.** Company-reported, July 2026.[^26]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
